metadata.title: ASR Implementation Options
metadata.description: Compare practical automatic speech recognition implementation paths for pilots, production workflows, and compliance-sensitive transcription.

options.title: Choose an ASR implementation path
options.description: The right path depends on audio volume, latency, privacy, speaker complexity, and how much review your team can support.

items.title: Pilot benchmark
items.description: Create a representative audio set, test word error rate, diarization, vocabulary, and review effort before selecting a model or vendor.

items.title: Workflow integration
items.description: Connect ASR output to captions, CRM records, QA queues, search indexes, analytics, or knowledge management systems.

items.title: Compliance-ready pipeline
items.description: Add retention policies, PII redaction, access control, audit logs, and human review rules for sensitive audio.

cta.title: Start with workflow sizing
cta.description: Use the ASR planner to estimate the recognition, review, and export requirements before committing to an implementation path.
